shortDescription: Maps limitation periods and computes candidate court deadlines. A lawyer must confirm each date.
longDescription: Creates a controlled litigation-deadline practice profile, maps described causes of action to candidate limitation periods across all nine Australian jurisdictions, computes candidate procedural and tribunal deadlines with a bundled deterministic script over evidence-gated computation-rule tables and verified holiday tables, verifies those tables against official publishers, and maintains a source-linked matter deadline register. The model never performs date arithmetic, unverified periods fail closed to identify-only output, and every date remains provisional until the responsible lawyer confirms it.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled litigation-deadline practice profile before mapping or computing any deadlines.
Map the candidate limitation periods across Australian jurisdictions for this cause of action.
Compute the candidate procedural deadline for this trigger event using the bundled script and rule tables.
Map the merits-review and tribunal deadlines that could apply to this administrative decision.
Verify the deadline computation-rule tables and holiday tables against the official publishers.
Update this matter's deadline register with source-linked entries and confirmation status.
whatItDoes: Maps described causes of action to candidate limitation periods across all nine jurisdictions with special-regime flags and a conservative earliest-candidate marker
Computes candidate procedural and tribunal deadlines with a bundled deterministic script over evidence-gated rule tables and verified holiday tables for every State and Territory
Maintains a source-linked matter deadline register and verifies the rule tables against official publishers with an evidence fingerprint
boundaries: Every date is provisional until the responsible lawyer confirms it — the plugin is not a diary or practice-management system
The model never performs date arithmetic; unexpressible or unverified periods fail closed to identify-only output
Never determines accrual, discoverability or extension prospects
Criminal procedure and foreign limitation law are excluded; migration outputs always carry a specialist-review warning
